subject: Re: RadarLytics benchmark download — 30min quick walkthrough?

From: Samir Patel <samir@radarlytics.com>

Cc: Elena Brooks <elena@radarlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Downloaded RadarLytics benchmark — interested in a short walkthrough

Hi Jonas,

I downloaded the RadarLytics benchmarking report from your site this morning — thanks for making this public, very useful. We're evaluating inference vendors for semantic search & embeddings at RadarLytics, and I'd like to schedule a short 30-minute walkthrough to cover:

- A quick tour of Redwood's latency/cost tradeoffs for embedding-heavy workloads
- How prefix caching and batching might map to our 90M document corpus
- Any recommended model/quantization combos for reducing TCO

Would you have 30 minutes next week? Prefer afternoons EST but flexible. I'm looping in Elena (product) — she'll join if schedule permits.

I attached the export we generated from our internal test harness in case that's helpful.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director, Search & Data Products
RadarLytics
Attachment: radarlytics_benchmark_full.csv (CSV, 2.3MB)

- Tue 11/16 11:00–11:30am EST (08:00am PST)
- Wed 11/17 02:00–02:30pm EST (11:00am PST)
- Thu 11/18 04:00–04:30pm EST (01:00pm PST)

Or grab a slot directly: https://cal.redwood.com/j/jonas/30min

If you can confirm timezone preference and which of the slots works, I'll send a calendar invite.

—Jonas
